_comment: Sound overrides: map an SFX name to a file in this folder (see README.md). Music: name each song ONCE under "tracks", then point slots at it under "music". Slots fall back most-specific -> general -> "default". Sound effects (M7d ElevenLabs pack in audio/sfx/) are listed under "sfx".
_m10_levels: M10: vol = playback gain only (files untouched), set from measured loudness so every song plays at ~the same level: bighouse -15.5 LUFS, the rest -14.3..-14.5 LUFS

shadowblades._note: M9D: 'Shadow Blades' (BEER-FAST, Suno) - every boss fight. lazy = fetched once a stage starts, not on the title screen

shadowed._note: M10: 'Shadowed Depths' (Bighouse, Suno) - Act I (coin-flip with bighouse on stages 1-2), stages 7 & 10. Audio copied as-is.

echoes._note: M10: 'Echoes of Battle' (Bighouse, Suno share D3KOXTXP8an9Ecei) - boss fights, alternating with Shadow Blades; always the Lich. Audio copied as-is.

echoes2._note: M10: 'Echoes of Battle' second version (Bighouse, Suno share EexaJkbPzIgekwOU) - the Act II theme. Audio copied as-is.

music.title: bighouse
music._example_overrides: add e.g. "boss_lich": "lichsong" or "stage_abyss": "voidsong" once those tracks exist in "tracks"
music._m10_map: M10 soundtrack director (js/m10a.js) fills m10_stage / m10_boss live: title+Chapel+victory bighouse | S1/S2 coin flip shadowed<->bighouse, S3 = S1's song | S4-S6 echoes2 | S7 shadowed, S8 echoes2, S9 bighouse, S10 shadowed | Abyss echoes2 | bosses alternate shadowblades/echoes (random start per run), the Lich always echoes

sfx._comment: M7d ElevenLabs SFX pack. Each name -> audio/sfx/<name>.ogg|.mp3. Value = volume, or {vol, file, fixed, duck, max}. Generic names (swing, hit, step...) replace the synth sound; the rest are new events. Delete a line to get the synth sound back. fixed = no pitch/volume variation, duck = music level while it plays, max = simultaneous copies.
sfx._m12: M12: ElevenLabs one-shots that stand in for the last synth sounds (roar, ghost, glint, clink, stone, rattle, screech, toll, howl, windup, pickup, groan, wing, giggle) plus the ranged-foe charge cue. Only used when m12 is on (js/m12f.js routes SFX.play(name) -> m12_name).
sfx._m13: M13: ElevenLabs one-shots for the m13 content (sigils, Veil Stalker blink, mini-boss cards, hook, hex volley, relic effects). Only triggered by js/m13*.js, so ?m13=0 never plays them.

_m12_levels: M12: boss gains re-measured in-game (40-sample RMS at the music bus, 7 s after the crossfade): stages 0.038-0.050, Shadow Blades 0.062 -> vol 0.49->0.40, Echoes 0.036 -> vol 0.51->0.70 (boss music now ~0.05, a hair above stage music). Files untouched.
_m13e: M13E adaptive music (js/m13e.js): sections cut from COPIES of every song into audio/m13e/*.m4a|mp3 (bar-aligned, zero-crossing fades, 1-beat loop tails). Originals in this folder are untouched; stage_game_over_friend.* ('Game Over, Friend') and stage_recording_1046.* ('31.6s Recording (Nov 22 @ 10:46 PM)') are the unedited new songs. ?m13music=0 -> the m12 map below.
